say:3:1111402001:1.text: Did you all hear that voice just now?
say:3:1111402001:1.source_cn: 刚才那个声音，你们听到了吗？

say:4:1111402002:1.text: It must have been the Dusk Lord! He was calling out for Soren!
say:4:1111402002:1.source_cn: 一定是残阳神的声音，他竟然在呼唤索恩！

say:5:1111402003:1.text: The Dusk Lord says someone is disturbing his sleep. He must be talking about the treasure hunters that were fooled by the Syndicate!
say:5:1111402003:1.source_cn: 残阳神说，有人在打搅他的长眠，应该是指那些被骗去寻宝的人吧？

say:9:1111402005:1.text: The Dusk Lord said, "<style="highlight">that WHICH disturbs my sleep</style>." He wasn't talking about a person.

say:10:1111402006:1.text: Whatever it is... it must be something that a divine doesn't consider to be <style="highlight">human</style>.
say:10:1111402006:1.source_cn: 我想……至少在神明眼中，那一定<style=highl...
say:10:1111402006:1.male: Whatever it is... it must be something that a divine doesn't consider to be <style="highlight">human</style>.
say:10:1111402006:1.female: Whatever it is... it must be something that a divine doesn't consider to be <style="highlight">human</style>.

choice_prompt:11:1111402006.text: Whatever it is... it must be something that a divine doesn't consider to be <style="highlight">human</style>.
choice_prompt:11:1111402006.source_cn: 我想……至少在神明眼中，那一定<style=highlight>不是人类</style>。
choice_prompt:11:1111402006.male: Whatever it is... it must be something that a divine doesn't consider to be <style="highlight">human</style>.
choice_prompt:11:1111402006.female: Whatever it is... it must be something that a divine doesn't consider to be <style="highlight">human</style>.

say:12:1111402007:1.text: Most likely. But... Why would a Hypogean want to disturb the Dusk Lord's slumber...?
say:12:1111402007:1.source_cn: 似乎也没有其他可能性了。不过，恶魔为什么会在残阳神的长...
say:12:1111402007:1.male: Most likely. But... Why would a Hypogean want to disturb the Dusk Lord's slumber...?
say:12:1111402007:1.female: Most likely. But... Why would a Hypogean want to disturb the Dusk Lord's slumber...?

say:13:1111402009:1.text: All we can do is keep moving forward. The Crimson Highlands will be full of danger, so stay on your guard.
say:13:1111402009:1.source_cn: 只能继续前进了。进入深红高地后，四处都潜伏着危险，要多...
say:13:1111402009:1.male: All we can do is keep moving forward. The Crimson Highlands will be full of danger, so stay on your guard.
say:13:1111402009:1.female: All we can do is keep moving forward. The Crimson Highlands will be full of danger, so stay on your guard.

say:15:1111402008:1.text: Well, Berial is the type to stir up trouble while others are asleep.
say:15:1111402008:1.source_cn: 以贝利尔的个性，确实很像会在别人睡觉时捣乱。
say:15:1111402008:1.male: Well, Berial is the type to stir up trouble while others are asleep.
say:15:1111402008:1.female: Well, Berial is the type to stir up trouble while others are asleep.

say:0:1111403001:0.text: What's that on the ground? Maybe the Adamant Syndicate left it behind?
say:0:1111403001:0.source_cn: 地上那是什么？说不定是黑金商会留下的罪证。
say:0:1111403001:0.male: What's that on the ground? Maybe the Adamant Syndicate left it behind?
say:0:1111403001:0.female: What's that on the ground? Maybe the Adamant Syndicate left it behind?

say:0:1111403101:0.text: This paper has words all over it too! But I don't know enough words to read it...
say:0:1111403101:0.source_cn: 这里也有写着字的纸！卡卡认的字不多，看不懂。

say:0:1111403201:0.text: There are more pages up ahead. They appear to be from a diary.
say:0:1111403201:0.source_cn: 前面也有，好像还是日记。

say:0:1111403301:0.text: Another page. I wonder what happened here...?
say:0:1111403301:0.source_cn: 又找到了一页。这里究竟发生过什么……

say:1:1111404001:1.text: Are... are you real? Or just... another hallucination?
say:1:1111404001:1.source_cn: 你……是真人，还是……我的幻觉？
say:1:1111404001:1.male: Are... are you real? Or just... another hallucination?
say:1:1111404001:1.female: Are... are you real? Or just... another hallucination?

say:2:1111404002:1.text: It doesn't matter... Please don't go. I need someone by my side...
say:2:1111404002:1.source_cn: 无论是什么，求你了，留下来，我需要有人陪在我身边……
say:2:1111404002:1.male: It doesn't matter... Please don't go. I need someone by my side...
say:2:1111404002:1.female: It doesn't matter... Please don't go. I need someone by my side...

say:5:1111404004:1.text: Wh-What are you doing? Why did you cut yourself all of a sudden?!
say:5:1111404004:1.source_cn: 呀——你做什么？为什么突然用刀子刺伤自己！
say:5:1111404004:1.male: Wh-What are you doing? Why did you cut yourself all of a sudden?!
say:5:1111404004:1.female: Wh-What are you doing? Why did you cut yourself all of a sudden?!

say:6:1111404005:1.text: The pain keeps my mind clear... *Cough*...
say:6:1111404005:1.source_cn: 疼痛能让我保持清醒……咳咳……
say:6:1111404005:1.male: The pain keeps my mind clear... *Cough*...
say:6:1111404005:1.female: The pain keeps my mind clear... *Cough*...

say:7:1111404006:1.text: Please just listen to me... We never should have come here looking for treasure...
say:7:1111404006:1.source_cn: 让我把话说完……我们不该来这儿寻宝。
say:7:1111404006:1.male: Please just listen to me... We never should have come here looking for treasure...
say:7:1111404006:1.female: Please just listen to me... We never should have come here looking for treasure...

say:8:1111404007:1.text: They all went insane... And what's worse, I don't think there was ever any treasure here...
say:8:1111404007:1.source_cn: 所有人……都疯了，不，也许这里根本没什么宝藏……
say:8:1111404007:1.male: They all went insane... And what's worse, I don't think there was ever any treasure here...
say:8:1111404007:1.female: They all went insane... And what's worse, I don't think there was ever any treasure here...

say:0:1111404101:0.text: Did he... lose consciousness? Or is he...

say:3:1111404202:1.text: Should we take him somewhere safe?
say:3:1111404202:1.source_cn: 我们要把他送去安全的地方吗？

say:4:1111404203:1.text: A good deed like that would mean doubling back for miles, and we don't have that kind of time.
say:4:1111404203:1.source_cn: 那意味着我们要走很长一段回头路，现在没时间做善事。

say:5:1111404204:1.text: He doesn't have any discernible wounds on his body. My guess is that he simply passed out from exhaustion.
say:5:1111404204:1.source_cn: 他的身上没有明显外伤，昏倒的原因应该是过度疲劳。

say:6:1111404205:1.text: Then maybe we should leave him with some medicine and supplies? What do you think, Magister?
say:6:1111404205:1.source_cn: 要不，我们给他留下一些水和食物，还有药品？主人，你觉得行吗？
say:6:1111404205:1.male: Then maybe we should leave him with some medicine and supplies? What do you think, Magister?
say:6:1111404205:1.female: Then maybe we should leave him with some medicine and supplies? What do you think, Magister?

choice_prompt:7:1111404205.text: Then maybe we should leave him with some medicine and supplies? What do you think, Magister?
choice_prompt:7:1111404205.source_cn: 要不，我们给他留下一些水和食物，还有药品？主人，你觉得行吗？
choice_prompt:7:1111404205.male: Then maybe we should leave him with some medicine and supplies? What do you think, Magister?
choice_prompt:7:1111404205.female: Then maybe we should leave him with some medicine and supplies? What do you think, Magister?

say:8:1111404206:1.text: We may not know this man, but this is the least we can do.
say:8:1111404206:1.source_cn: 我们素不相识，做到这个份上已经足够了。
say:8:1111404206:1.male: We may not know this man, but this is the least we can do.
say:8:1111404206:1.female: We may not know this man, but this is the least we can do.

say:9:1111404208:0.text: We've already wasted too much time. Let's keep moving.
say:9:1111404208:0.source_cn: 继续赶路吧，已经耽误不少时间了。

say:11:1111404207:0.text: Our resources are already too scarce to share with strangers. I understand your decision.
say:11:1111404207:0.source_cn: 我们的资源也很紧缺，没有义务馈赠给他人，我能理解你的选择。
say:11:1111404207:0.male: Our resources are already too scarce to share with strangers. I understand your decision.
say:11:1111404207:0.female: Our resources are already too scarce to share with strangers. I understand your decision.

say:0:1111408001:0.text: Is this what they meant by "searching for treasure?" We need to save these poor Maulers, Magister!
say:0:1111408001:0.source_cn: 难道这就是所谓的挖掘宝藏？主人，我们得救救这些可怜的蛮血！
say:0:1111408001:0.male: Is this what they meant by "searching for treasure?" We need to save these poor Maulers, Magister!
say:0:1111408001:0.female: Is this what they meant by "searching for treasure?" We need to save these poor Maulers, Magister!

say:1:1111409001:0.text: Divines above... I confess that I have stolen my neighbor's terrabird eggs... and also made his roof leak...
say:1:1111409001:0.source_cn: 神明大人……我承认，我偷过邻居家的陆行鸟蛋……他家房顶...

say:2:1111409002:0.text: I was wrong, but please... I beg of you... Don't deprive me of the right to stay at the Dusk Lord's side...
say:2:1111409002:0.source_cn: 还请您……千万别剥夺我去残阳神身边的资格啊！我愿意认错……

say:4:1111409003:0.text: He's rambling... His injuries are serious, and his brain seems to have suffered damage too.
say:4:1111409003:0.source_cn: 胡言乱语……他看着伤得不轻，脑子都受影响了。

say:7:1111409004:1.text: He is at his limit and needs to take this.
say:7:1111409004:1.source_cn: 这位叔叔很虚弱，他需要吃下这个。

choice_prompt:8:1111409004.text: He is at his limit and needs to take this.
choice_prompt:8:1111409004.source_cn: 这位叔叔很虚弱，他需要吃下这个。

say:10:1111409006:0.text: Wait! A ball of muddy grass like that is only going to make him worse!
say:10:1111409006:0.source_cn: 等等！这东西像混着泥巴捏成的草团，人吃了要出事的！

say:11:1111409007:0.text: Antandra taught me how to make this! Not only will it fill his stomach, but it'll also purge his body of any toxins!
say:11:1111409007:0.source_cn: 这可是安丹姐姐教我做的团子！不止能填饱肚子，还能解毒治病呢！

say:13:1111409008:1.text: She's right, Satrana. I learned this recipe from a kind old man who I met during my travels.
say:13:1111409008:1.source_cn: 萨忒娜，我在旅途中遇到过一位老先生，这团子是他教我做的。

say:14:1111409009:1.text: It's made from a special red clay mixed with certain herbs, and is meant to be used for emergencies.
say:14:1111409009:1.source_cn: 用特殊的细腻红土混合草药搓制而成，在情况紧急的时候能派...

say:16:1111409011:1.text: See, Antandra? She doesn't trust you at all!
say:16:1111409011:1.source_cn: 安丹姐姐，你看，萨忒娜不相信你！

say:17:1111409012:1.text: That's not what I meant! Antandra is too trusting of other people; who's to say that this old man was telling the truth?
say:17:1111409012:1.source_cn: 我不是这个意思！我是怀疑那位来历不明的老先生，谁叫安丹...

say:18:1111409013:1.text: I've taken this before, Satrana. It's perfectly safe, I promise.
say:18:1111409013:1.source_cn: 我自己也曾服用过这团子，很安全。

say:19:1111409014:1.source_cn: 好吧，既然你都这么说了……

say:20:1111409015:1.text: I'll give it to him! Am I doing this right, Antandra?
say:20:1111409015:1.source_cn: 我喂叔叔吃下团子咯！安丹姐姐，我是不是做得很好？

say:21:1111409016:1.text: Well done, Koko. It looks like you're capable of taking good care of others now.
say:21:1111409016:1.source_cn: 卡卡已经是能够照顾别人的大孩子了。

say:22:1111409017:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿！安丹姐姐又夸我啦。

say:31:1111409021:1.text: I never expected... to wake up and see such a beautiful face looking down at me... Tell me, did the divines send you to rescue me, my fair lady?
say:31:1111409021:1.source_cn: 没想到……一睁开眼，竟然能看到你这般美丽的女性……是神...

say:33:1111409022:1.text: Let go! Don't you dare touch her!

say:34:1111409023:1.text: Ah! I-I'm sorry... I couldn't help myself just now...
say:34:1111409023:1.source_cn: 哎哟！对、对不起……我这是情不自禁……

say:35:1111409024:1.text: It's fine... If you're feeling better, then hurry up and leave. We don't have time to keep you company right now.
say:35:1111409024:1.source_cn: 行了行了……你要是已经恢复了，就赶快离开这里，我们忙着...

say:36:1111409025:1.text: Wait... You plan to keep going further? Don't you know how dangerous it is in there?!
say:36:1111409025:1.source_cn: 什么……你们还要向深处走吗？太危险了！

say:38:1111409027:1.text: Even if you manage to resist the hallucinations... You won't make it past the Webbed Wall, or the bloodthirsty spiders that made them! They'll eat you alive!
say:38:1111409027:1.source_cn: 就算你们能抵抗那些幻觉……也根本不可能走过蛛网戈壁！那...

say:39:1111409028:1.text: Spiders? ... Understood. Thank you for the warning.
say:39:1111409028:1.source_cn: 蜘蛛吗……知道了，感谢你的提醒。

say:40:1111409029:1.text: You really are going, aren't you? Please, just be careful around those spiders!
say:40:1111409029:1.source_cn: 啊……你们真的要去吗？千万要当心那些蜘蛛！

say:0:1111410001:0.text: The webs are sticking to my dress... Gross!
say:0:1111410001:0.source_cn: 蜘蛛丝都黏在了我的裙子上……真讨厌。

say:1:1111410002:0.text: I'm amazed you're not afraid of spiders, Hammie.
say:1:1111410002:0.source_cn: 漫漫好厉害，你居然不怕蜘蛛。

say:2:1111410003:0.text: What's there to be afraid of? They're just oversized bugs, that's all. Besides, I'm <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s familiar!
say:2:1111410003:0.source_cn: 区区蜘蛛，不过是体型大了点，我才不怕呢。我可是<sty...
say:2:1111410003:0.male: What's there to be afraid of? They're just oversized bugs, that's all. Besides, I'm <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s familiar!
say:2:1111410003:0.female: What's there to be afraid of? They're just oversized bugs, that's all. Besides, I'm <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s familiar!

say:0:1111410301:0.text: Are you okay, Satrana? Your face is covered in sweat.
say:0:1111410301:0.source_cn: 萨忒娜，你还好吗？我看你的额头渗出许多汗珠。

say:1:1111410302:0.text: T-that's because I hate spiders! M-My prophecy didn't say anything about a gigantic spider nest!
say:1:1111410302:0.source_cn: 因为我很讨厌蜘蛛！预言可没告诉我，我会遇到这么大一个蜘...

say:0:1111410401:0.text: There weren't any spiders the last time I was here. Then again, I can't even remember how long ago that was...
say:0:1111410401:0.source_cn: 我上次来，这里还没有蜘蛛呢。但我也不记得上次是多久之前了……

say:1:1111410402:0.text: That's because you have no sense of time whatsoever...
say:1:1111410402:0.source_cn: 是因为你根本就没什么时间观念吧……

say:0:1111411001:0.text: This place gives me the creeps... So many lives must have been lost here.
say:0:1111411001:0.source_cn: 这地方真叫人毛骨悚然……一定有不少生命在此消逝。

say:1:1111411002:0.text: Those spider sacs over there are making noise. Could there be people trapped in them?
say:1:1111411002:0.source_cn: 那边的蜘蛛卵里好像有声音，难道有人被困在里面？

say:0:1111412001:0.text: The spider coughed up a sticky piece of parchment. What was this doing in its belly?
say:0:1111412001:0.source_cn: 蜘蛛吐出了一张黏糊糊的羊皮纸，它肚子里怎么会有这种东西？

say:1:1111412002:0.text: My guess is that it belonged to an unfortunate adventurer.

say:2:1111413001:0.text: Looks like stuff from the Adamant Syndicate,

say:3:1111413002:0.text: Even though the Claws rounded up a bunch of folks to do their bidding, some of them couldn't escape the spiders' venomous fangs.
say:3:1111413002:0.source_cn: 虽然抓了一群人替自己干活，但还是有些倒霉的家伙，最终没...

say:4:1111413003:0.text: Looks like the Adamant Syndicate also managed to trick the Quicksand Claws to get in.
say:4:1111413003:0.source_cn: 这么说来，流沙之爪也被黑金商会摆了一道。

say:5:1111413004:0.text: Ferranc thought he was digging for treasure when, in reality, he was just digging a tunnel to avoid the spider nest.
say:5:1111413004:0.source_cn: 弗兰克还以为要挖宝藏，没想到只是为了绕开蜘蛛巢穴而挖地道。

say:6:1111413005:0.text: For once, I'm starting to feel bad about his death.
say:6:1111413005:0.source_cn: 我第一次为他的死而遗憾。

say:8:1111413007:0.text: Because I didn't get a chance to see the look on his face when he dug up a bunch of the spider sacs.
say:8:1111413007:0.source_cn: 我很好奇他挖出一堆蜘蛛卵时，脸上是什么表情。

say:9:1111413008:0.text: Oh... When you put it that way, I kind of wish I could've seen it too.
say:9:1111413008:0.source_cn: 嗯……你这么一说，我也有点好奇了。

say:0:1111413101:0.text: The sandy soil here is rich with rare minerals, all of which give it this distinctly red hue.
say:0:1111413101:0.source_cn: 这里的沙土富含稀有矿物，所有才会呈现出鲜艳的红色。

say:1:1111413102:0.text: No wonder so many alchemists from Savannah want to visit this place.
say:1:1111413102:0.source_cn: 难怪赛凡纳有不少炼金术师都想来这里看看。

say:0:1111413201:0.text: Why don't we all sing a song? Whenever I'm feeling afraid, I like to sing something brave and uplifting...
say:0:1111413201:0.source_cn: 你们想不想唱唱歌？我害怕的时候，总会高歌一曲壮壮胆子……

say:1:1111413202:0.text: Count me out. Alsa once said that my singing sounds like a battle roar, and that it's only good for scaring people.
say:1:1111413202:0.source_cn: 我就算了，阿尔萨说过我的歌声像是战吼，会吓到别人。

say:0:1111413301:0.text: You still remember that treasure-hunting hamster? Chippy doesn't want to see him show up in a dangerous place like this.
say:0:1111413301:0.source_cn: 还记得那只寻宝仓鼠吗？它可千万不要跑到这么危险的地方来。

say:0:1111413401:0.text: These sacs seem to contain other animals, too.
say:0:1111413401:0.source_cn: 这些蜘蛛卵内似乎还包裹着其他动物。

say:1:1111413402:0.text: Is this how the spiders store their food for later...?
say:1:1111413402:0.source_cn: 那是蜘蛛储藏食物的方式吧……

say:0:1111414001:0.text: We finally found it... The Dusk Lord's final resting place.
say:0:1111414001:0.source_cn: 终于到了……残阳神的安眠之地。

say:1:1111414002:0.text: The entrance is just up ahead. Get ready, everyone.
say:1:1111414002:0.source_cn: 入口在前方，准备好了就出发吧。

say:0:1111415001:0.text: This sandstorm is fierce! It feels like I'm about to be blown to the heavens!
say:0:1111415001:0.source_cn: 沙暴可真大！我快被吹到天上去了！

say:0:1111416001:0.source_cn: 入口在前面！终于找到了！

say:1:1111416002:0.text: I'm not so eager to go in now... but at least it's a shelter.
say:1:1111416002:0.source_cn: 忽然不是很想进去……但里面好歹还能躲避沙暴……

subtitle:1:1111401001:.text: Thy name is Soren... Thou are my chosen.
subtitle:1:1111401001:.source_cn: 汝名……索恩，汝乃吾选定之人

subtitle:1:1111401002:.text: I bequeath unto thee great power.
subtitle:1:1111401002:.source_cn: 吾已将至高力量赐予你

subtitle:1:1111401003:.text: Go forth... And repel that which disturbs my slumber.
subtitle:1:1111401003:.source_cn: 去吧，将打搅吾长眠之物……驱逐
